card.name: Punctuation ending a dictionary definition
card.fires_on: Punctuation (comma, colon, period) right after a short dictionary gloss, just before an example phrase or the next sense. Also the 'AD' ending of the abbreviation CDAD.

modes.label: Dictionary definition punctuation
